name: Milky crystal focus
description: A milky white crystal cluster gripped in a three-pronged steel claw on a heavy round foot. Splinters of the same crystal hang in the air above it and do not fall. Close to it, your own thoughts seem loud.
notes: 144 by 240 by 148 mm, the cluster 48 mm across in a claw on a 140 mm foot. CHECK VOLUME (x6.82): the reference's 750 ml is the metal and crystal; the floating splinters and the open claw make its box mostly air. The splinters float clear of the crystal on purpose. The crystal is `pearl` because no glowing white crystal finish exists; the splinters are `gem-clear`, see-through in the game. The reference gives it no qualities; it is a crafting focus like batch 204's crystal focusing ring, so it takes `mana_focus` one level higher for telepathic work.

name: Crystal-cell flashlight
description: A household flashlight whose battery tube has been swapped for a blue crystal rod, seen through a small glass window in its body. Its lens is cut from the same crystal. The light is a little dimmer than a battery bulb but lasts far longer.
notes: 140 mm long, 40 mm across the head. Off and on are one item with a switch, so the lit state shares this model and gets its light from a `light` block like the flashlight's, with a cooler blue colour and a slow crystal charge drain instead of a battery. That drain needs a crystal power source, which does not exist yet.

name: Crystal lantern
description: A squat aluminium camp lantern with a domed lid hinged shut and a wire bail handle. A thin line of blue light leaks out under the lid; opening it lets out a wide, cold glow that lasts far longer than any battery lamp.
notes: 116 by 172 by 120 mm with the handle and lugs, the canister 100 mm across. The covered state is modelled; the open state is a switch on the same item, so it rides on this model. Its glow needs a `light` block with a blue colour and a crystal power source, which does not exist yet. Box/volume x2.39: the reference's 1 l is the canister; the bail and lid stand clear of it.

name: Crystal floor lamp
description: A tall floor lamp on a weighted steel base, its white cone shade hiding a blue crystal rod where the bulb should be. A power cord trails from its foot to a loose plug. Plugged in, it lights a room on a fraction of the power.
notes: 1.71 m tall, a 300 mm base and a 400 mm shade, 590 mm wide with the cord laid out. CHECK VOLUME (x201.78): the reference's 2 l is the metal and plastic; a floor lamp's box is almost all air. The disconnected state is modelled; plugged in and lit, it rides on the same model. Use as a placed light needs a mains power rule, which does not exist yet.

name: Lump of condensed chaos
description: A lump of something like black glass, three swollen lobes run together, with an oily rainbow sheen and violet flecks sunk in its skin. It looks hard but gives under a finger, and it weighs almost nothing. The air round it tingles.
notes: 88 by 54 by 60 mm, 10 g. The reference gives no material; the model is `void-black` with `iridescent` patches and `crystal-glow-violet` flecks. It is a crafting reagent for crystal devices; it gets a recipe role once those recipes exist.

name: Crystal-topped beacon
description: A stepped dark-grey pyramid on a steel plate, a blue crystal column on its peak, a sight tube of teal fluid across its front and a small control panel. Four lumps of black glassy stone are set round its foot like guard posts.
notes: 388 by 364 by 312 mm with the stones, the pyramid 260 mm square and 240 mm tall. CHECK VOLUME (x22.03): the reference's 2 l is the solid parts; the stones stand apart at the corners and the pyramid tapers, so its box is mostly air. The stones are `chitin-black`, the closest glassy black; no dark glassy stone finish exists. It is placed and paired with the crystal handset to teleport the carrier to it, which needs a teleport action that does not exist yet.

name: Crystal-antenna handset
description: A chunky handset like an old keypad phone crossed with a radio, with a small blank screen, nine rubber keys and a little window of teal fluid. A stubby blue crystal rod sticks out of its top like an antenna.
notes: 100 by 55 by 32 mm, 148 mm long with the crystal rod. It pairs with the crystal-topped beacon to teleport the carrier to it, which needs a teleport action that does not exist yet.
